Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to deliver accurate, context-aware responses for enterprise Knowledge Base applications. Solid understanding of LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and vector databases. Experience taking over or maintaining vendor-developed AI solutions is a strong advantage. Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, security, and compliance requirements is preferred. Good command of English; Mandarin is required. Personal Attributes Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-evolving environment. Practical and delivery-oriented, with a focus on building production-ready AI solutions rather than only prototyping. Collaborative team player who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Eager to stay at the forefront of AI technology and continuously improve internal capabilities.
